# LocoraAI

> LocoraAI (https://locoraai.com) is an AI business-growth platform that helps local businesses get found on Google and cited by AI assistants like ChatGPT. It combines a free business checkup, local SEO tooling, Google Business Profile and review management, CRM, proposals and invoicing in one workspace.

## Entity facts

- **Official name:** LocoraAI
- **Website:** https://locoraai.com
- **Contact:** support@locoraai.com — https://locoraai.com/contact
- **What it is:** A software platform for local businesses and the agencies that serve them. Core tools: a free business checkup, local SEO and Google Business Profile tooling, review management, a client CRM, proposal generation and invoicing.
- **Who it is for:** Local service businesses and small agencies. Dedicated pages exist for dental practices, HVAC contractors, real estate agents, law firms, plumbers, med spas, restaurants and auto repair businesses.
- **Pricing:** Free Explorer — $0, 25 credits/month. Pro — $29/month or $249/year, 250 credits. Agency Elite — $99/month. Full details: https://locoraai.com/pricing
- **Free business checkup:** https://locoraai.com/checkup — scans a business's public website and scores it across six categories (technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO, content, structured data, performance), including how consistent the business name, phone and address are and whether LocalBusiness structured data is present. The score and top issues are shown without signup or a credit card. The checkup does not access a business's private Google Business Profile data; connecting a profile inside a LocoraAI workspace is what syncs live reviews and Map Pack tracking.
- **Business directory:** https://locoraai.com/directory — a public directory of verified local businesses.

## Original research

- **How Dentists Get Recommended by ChatGPT — a 35-practice study:** https://locoraai.com/resources/how-dentists-get-recommended-by-chatgpt — In November 2026, LocoraAI asked ChatGPT, Google's AI Overview and Gemini six patient questions about dentists in Logan, Utah, twice on two different days (36 answers), and recorded which of 35 real practices were named. 11 of the 35 were named at all; 24 were never named. Review counts alone did not decide it: a practice with 473 reviews and a 5.0 rating received zero mentions, and so did one with 684 reviews. The study page publishes the full findings and the playbook that follows from them.
